text:
marta: Following the postmortem, I set up a small sprint to close the high-priority remediation items. I'm proposing a 'sherpa' model — one person to shepherd the tickets each week until done. Initial tickets: RW-2345, RW-2378, RW-2401. Can someone volunteer to be this week's sherpa?
jorge: I can take the first week. I'll own RW-2345 (cache eviction tuning) and RW-2378 (alerting gaps).
priya: Thanks Jorge. For RW-2378 can you link the failing query logs? Blocking question: do we need an infra change or an alert rule tweak?
alex: Quick note: RW-2401 (runbook updates) needs SME review from eng-sre, I can coordinate that with Sam.
sam: happy to review RW-2401. ping me when the draft is ready. Also +1 on the sherpa idea.
marta: Great. Jorge — can you add a short acceptance criteria to each ticket so the sherpa handoff is clear? Example: RW-2345 -> "reduce 95th p99 by 30% or implement config with rollback plan".
jorge: Yep. I'll update now. Also adding ETA: end of next Tues for initial changes.
priya: @jorge please also add owner for post-deploy verification and add smoke test steps.
jorge: will do.
oncall-bot: Incident followup reminder: PM action owner checklist due in 5 days for postmortem 2024-03-08.
marta: FYI I'm adding a RACI section on the PM doc. Proposed RACI: R=Jorge (sherpa), A=Marta (pm), C=EngSRE + Observability, I=All teams. Any objections?
alex: looks good. Suggest adding "backstop owner" in case the sherpa is unavailable. Maybe Sam?
sam: I can be the backstop for week 1.
priya: For tracking, can we have a single parent Jira epic so we can run velocity and SLA checks?
marta: yes — creating epic now and will link the tickets.
jira-bot: Created epic RW-3010: "PM remediation sprint - week 1 sherpa" and linked RW-2345, RW-2378, RW-2401.
marta: Perfect. Jorge — once you've updated tickets with acceptance criteria, post the links here and I'll add them to the postmortem. Also set the sprint label so ops can pull reports.
jorge: Done: RW-2345, RW-2378, RW-2401 updated. Acceptance criteria + smoke tests added. Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-2345 , https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-2378 , https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-2401
priya: quick question on RW-2345 mitigation — are we planning to ship a config flag or a code change?
jorge: config flag first (safer), code change if perf doesn't improve. documented in RW-2345.
alex: I'll allocate one eng-sre cycle to validate the config change in staging.
marta: Thanks everyone. Weekly check-in scheduled Thu 10:30am; Jorge please prepare a 5-min status update and blockers. If anything slips, ping the backstop (Sam). Closing the loop here. :white_check_mark:
